tool.name: nf-core ngmerge
tool.description: Merging paired-end reads and removing sequencing adapters.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ NGmerge \\ -1 ${reads[0]} \\ -2 ${reads[1]} \\ -o ${prefix}.merged.fq.gz \\ -f ${prefix}_unstitched \\ -z \\ -n $task.cpus \\ $args
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": NGmerge: \$(echo \$(NGmerge --version 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*NGmerge, version //; s/ Copyright.*// ; s/: //g' )) END_VERSIONS ]]>
